dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, can you help me? I'm writing a quiz about inventions for the class.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈhɛlp miː? aɪm ˈraɪtɪŋ ə ˈkwɪz əˈbaʊt ɪnˈvɛnʃənz fər ðə ˈklæs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: First question: when was the phone invented?
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst ˈkwɛstʃən: ˈwɛn wʌz ðə ˈfoʊn ɪnˈvɛntɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ɪnˈvɛntɪd ɪn ˌeɪˈtiːn ˈsɛvənti ˈsɪks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Correct! Next: where were noodles first made?
dialogue.reading: kəˈrɛkt! ˈnɛkst: ˈwɛr wɜːr ˈnuːdəlz ˈfɜːrst ˈmeɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In China, I think. They were made there about four thousand years ago.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈtʃaɪnə, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. ðeɪ wɜːr ˈmeɪd ðɛr əˈbaʊt ˈfɔːr ˈθaʊzənd ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Very good. Now, was penicillin invented or discovered?
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd. ˈnaʊ, wʌz ˌpɛnɪˈsɪlɪn ɪnˈvɛntɪd ɔːr dɪˈskʌvərd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It wasn't invented. It was discovered in 1928.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈwʌzənt ɪnˈvɛntɪd. ɪt wʌz dɪˈskʌvərd ɪn ˌnaɪnˈtiːn ˈtwɛnti ˈeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Right. So what's the difference between an invention and a discovery?
dialogue.reading: ˈraɪt. soʊ ˈwʌts ðə ˈdɪfrəns bɪˈtwiːn ən ɪnˈvɛnʃən ənd ə dɪˈskʌvəri?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: An invention is something new that people make. A discovery is something that was already there.
dialogue.reading: ən ɪnˈvɛnʃən ɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈnuː ðæt ˈpiːpəl ˈmeɪk. ə dɪˈskʌvəri ɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt wʌz ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Last question: who is your favorite inventor?
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt. ˈlæst ˈkwɛstʃən: ˈhuː ɪz jʊr ˈfeɪvərɪt ɪnˈvɛntər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The Wright brothers. The first plane was flown in 1903!
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈraɪt ˈbrʌðərz. ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈpleɪn wʌz ˈfloʊn ɪn ˌnaɪnˈtiːn ˈoʊ ˈθriː!
